# v2026.10.53-4

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.53-4.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.53-4.md).

This release covers **8 pull requests, with thanks to 2 contributors.**

## Highlights

- Flow keeps source invoice totals and blocks unsent drafts when source tax does not agree. ([#464](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/464))
- Send shows progress and blocks repeat requests until the result arrives. ([#460](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/460))
- Daily checks no longer report existing non-billable jobs as missing. ([#463](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/463))
- Seazona discovery revisits earlier order dates without delaying new jobs. ([#455](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/455))
- An issued invoice shows why Xero refused it. ([#444](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/444)) Thanks [@RoboForgeBot](https://github.com/RoboForgeBot).
- A read field goes to the custom field of the same name; mark work system fields. ([#389](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/389)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Quieter Custom fields page (New button, no empty text or count). ([#409](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/409))

## Changes

- A read field goes to the custom field of the same name; mark work system fields. ([#389](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/389)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Quieter Custom fields page (New button, no empty text or count). ([#409](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/409))

## Fixes

- Flow keeps explicit source invoice totals, including zero tax. Unknown discount tax stays unknown. Source conflicts block unsent drafts. ([#464](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/464))
- Send shows progress and blocks repeat requests. Cancel restores focus when the control remains connected. ([#460](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/460))
- Daily checks no longer report existing non-billable jobs as missing. ([#463](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/463))
- Seazona discovery revisits earlier order dates without delaying new jobs. ([#455](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/455))
- An issued invoice shows why Xero refused it. ([#444](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/444)) Thanks [@RoboForgeBot](https://github.com/RoboForgeBot).
